articles.title: Memento 3: Model-Based Recursive Self-Improvement through Reflective Rulebooks

articles.title: Post-Training Frontier Text-to-Image Models by Composing Preference and Rubric Rewards

articles.title: Embodied Turing Machines: Stateful Code for Robot Recursive Self-Improvement

articles.title: OmniCapBench: A Deep-Structured Evaluation Framework for Fine-Grained Audio-Visual Captioning

articles.title: Do LLMs Understand Sequential Structure? A Controlled Study of Inference and Generation

articles.title: Opera: A Verbal Critic Framework for Long-horizon Coding Agents

articles.summary: Opera 是一个针对长程编程代理的口头评价（Verbal Critic）框架。该框架通过跟踪反馈执行后的状态变化，解决了传统评估方法无法区分反馈是否有效或有害的问题，从而实现更精准的长期任务纠错。

articles.title: ReSPO: Reshaped Sequence Policy Optimization for Gradient Starvation in Off-Policy Learning

articles.title: REMORY: Learning Residual Memory for Context Compaction

articles.title: A Closer Look at Agentic BBO: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Black-Box Optimization

articles.summary: 本文对基于 LLM 代理的黑盒优化（BBO）进行了基准测试。研究指出，通过结合任务语义与反馈驱动的决策，LLM 为处理昂贵且有限的客观评估问题提供了一种极具潜力的路径，并明确了其当前的优劣势。

articles.title: Accurate but Not Humble: Evaluating Epistemic Humility in LLM Agents under Knowledge Conflict
